items.heading: Fufu with Groundnut Soup
details: Key ingredients: cassava, plantain, peanut paste, meat
Boil cassava and plantain until soft.
Pound them together into a smooth, stretchy dough.
Simmer meat in a peanut sauce with tomato until tender.
Serve the pounded dough alongside the peanut soup.

items.heading: Akoume with Fish Sauce
details: Key ingredients: corn dough, tomato, fish, chili
Cook fermented corn dough with water, stirring into a smooth paste.
Continue cooking until it thickens and turns glossy.
Simmer fish in a spicy tomato sauce.
Serve the corn dough alongside the fish sauce.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
